verdict.rationale: Clerky has a Partner API and a remote MCP server, but neither covers NDA drafting or signature routing. The Partner API currently supports only Delaware C-Corp formations, its OAuth access is "coming soon", and signing happens on Clerky rather than being routed by the caller. The probe indicates the MCP server exposes read-only, team-scoped tools, and no evidence shows NDAs or any agent-driven drafting-to-signature flow.
